decisions.statement: A row holding its own under a key reads the same as a row holding it flat.
A slug opens with the game's own, so two games may hold the same name.
A class the old engine wrote as none is no class.
The dice a sheet says are read as the mechanic rolling them.
An empty list is left off rather than written empty.

definition: the page one of an old engine's rows becomes, for what a game's world holds
